record.question: His shoes were dirty because he _________ in the rain.
record.explanation: Answer B: had been walking. Had been walking describes the prior ongoing action that left his shoes dirty (B). Independent check: The ongoing earlier activity explains the dirty shoes; past perfect continuous “had been walking” conveys duration before the past result. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/past-perfect-continuous. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
